changelog:
Initial release of the Claw Security Self-Check skill:

- Provides a strict, evidence-based, read-only security assessment for the current OpenClaw host.
- Automatically identifies and targets NOT_TESTED items for OpenClaw Agent review, merging structured evidence into a formal audit report.
- Supports two modes: baseline (live host + manual review) and report-only (offline JSON report generation/merge).
- Enforces strict non-invasive rules: no credential exposure, no configuration changes, no active validation beyond documented scripts.
- Returns detailed statuses, evidence for failures, and precise report file locations.
- Includes explicit user guidance for manual review actions and secure report handling.
